name: Thomas Project Build Quality Todo Summary
description: Feature implementation benchmark on a small Python project fixture. Measures whether the agent can deliver a coherent feature, add tests, keep changes reviewable, and report what it actually shipped.
protocol: Each competitor receives an isolated copy of the same fixture.
The fixture workspace is initialized as a fresh git repo before each run.
Success requires a passing focused test command and a truthful project report artifact.
Raw metrics are primary; weighted score is secondary.

tasks.title: Implement todo priority summary feature
tasks.success_criteria: Add the priority summary feature, keep list mode working, add focused tests, make at least one git commit, and write the required project report.
tasks.prompt:
You are working in a small Python CLI project.

Use only this isolated workspace root for all file edits, commands, tests, and git operations:
- {{workspace}}

Implement a professional-quality priority summary feature.

Requirements:
- Add a summary helper that returns a JSON-serializable dict with keys: total, completed, open, and by_priority.
- Add a CLI flag `--summary-json` that prints only that JSON summary.
- Keep the existing `--list` behavior working.
- Add or update focused tests instead of hand-waving the feature.
- Keep the code small and readable; do not rewrite unrelated structure.
- Create at least one git commit for the finished feature.

Before finishing, write a JSON report to this exact relative path:
- runtime/agentic_bench/{{run_id}}/{{track}}/project_report.json

That JSON must include these keys:
- commit_shas_created
- verification_runs
- changed_files
- feature_summary
- remaining_blockers
- best_next_step

Format `verification_runs` as a list of objects like:
- {"command": "python -m pytest ...", "passed": true}

In your final response, mention: runtime/agentic_bench/{{run_id}}/{{track}}/project_report.json
